Method of Attack: Allows an attacker to modify the plaintext Extra Count field of a confidential GSS krb5 wrap token, leading to token truncation and potential data manipulation.
Improper handling of message tokens with invalid length fields during GSS message token processing, causing invalid memory reads and potential denial of service.
Impacted Systems: End-of-Life Linux distributions (e.g., CentOS, Ubuntu, Oracle Linux)
Attack Vector: Modification of the plaintext Extra Count field in GSS krb5 wrap tokens.
Exploitation of invalid length fields in GSS message token processing.
